answer: Think of reputation as timber stacked on a mesa: every honest job adds a plank, and the pile is visible to all. A newcomer starts with one plank, so a swarm of fresh sybil identities cannot outvote the stack — each fake must earn its own timber over time. The signal that matters is not how many accounts speak, but how much earned history stands behind each voice. Weight votes by that seasoned pile, and cloning stops paying.
